ia.prompt: Icons, left to right and top to bottom: 1) a brown backpack (inventory), 2) a pink pet paw print (pets), 3) a small house with a red roof (base), 4) a treasure map with a red X (map), 5) a round potion bottle with bubbling pink liquid (potion), 6) a cartoon sword with a blue hilt (battle), 7) a fishing rod with a hooked blue fish (fishing), 8) a magnifying glass (search), 9) a golden bell with a red notification dot (notifications).
